question: Will the 12-month change in U.S. average hourly earnings of all private employees (BLS, seasonally adjusted; computed from the level) for May 2026 (the latest monthly reading dated on or before 2026-05-15) be above 3.43%, its value for March 2026?

rule.threshold_basis: the latest reading as of 2026-04-15 (March 2026), rounded as shown

source: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
